categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Meili Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end spring products. Its main product categories include suspension system springs, body and interior springs, power system springs, general springs, elastic devices and stamping parts, and precision injection molded parts. The company mainly serves the automotive parts industry but also extends to engineering machinery, aerospace, electric power, military, nuclear power, valves, and robotics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including cold and hot forming for suspension springs and stabilizer bars, and holds proprietary materials technology such as the ML1900 high-strength, high-toughness spring steel. It has multiple patents and software copyrights, operates a national postdoctoral workstation, and has developed industry-leading manufacturing equipment including the world's largest diameter cold coil equipment for new energy vehicle springs. Production is characterized by multi-variety, small batch, and customized manufacturing aligned with OEM orders.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international automotive manufacturers including Geely, BYD, BMW Brilliance, Li Auto, NIO, XPeng, SAIC General Motors, Changan, Great Wall Motors, and international OEMs like Hyundai and Jaguar Land Rover. The company also supplies global Tier 1 automotive parts suppliers such as Mando, ZF, Faurecia, Lear, and Magna. Approximately 90% of revenue derives from the automotive parts industry, with growing sales in new energy vehicles and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Zhejiang (Shaoxing, Haining, Xinchang), Beijing, Jilin (Changchun), Jiangsu (Yancheng), and Shanghai. It has expanded internationally with wholly-owned subsidiaries in Singapore, the United States (Houston), and Germany (North Rhine-Westphalia). Domestic operations cover major automotive clusters including the Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin, and Northeast China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Meili Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier of high-end springs and related components directly to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 parts manufacturers. It manages raw material procurement, in-house manufacturing, product development, and direct sales to OEMs, with logistics handled by its own and third-party providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation aligned with automotive electrification, intelligence, lightweighting, and integration trends. R&D priorities include developing lightweight, high fatigue life, and high strength new materials, as well as new product lines such as intelligent suspension assemblies and electric/hydraulic elastic components. It invests in digital transformation to enhance supply chain and manufacturing efficiency through integrated SRM, WMS, MES, and financial systems. International expansion and strengthening group management and talent development are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of spring products and automotive components to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. Sales are based on framework contracts and monthly orders, with revenue recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns, but product sales constitute the core revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic spring manufacturer with strong brand recognition and competitive advantages in technology and production capabilities. It competes with other automotive spring and parts manufacturers both domestically and internationally. Its acquisition of companies like Beijing Dayuan and Jiangsu Dayuan and integration of German Ahle technology enhance its market position. It is recognized as a 'specialized and innovative' enterprise by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.6 billion, a 16.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 106.7 million, up 162%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.17 billion with a net asset increase of 9.6%. It has shown consistent growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding domestic and international markets and improved capacity utilization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Meili Technology emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced spring products tailored to automotive OEM requirements, including new energy vehicles. Its unique value lies in proprietary materials technology, comprehensive R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing equipment, and integrated supply chain management. The company offers customized, multi-variety production with strong system integration from parts to assemblies, providing reliable, innovative solutions that enhance vehicle safety, comfort, and performance.
